summary: Honor native output rolls when selecting useful productivity recipes.
details: Require a positive valid independent/shared output roll before a recipe can supply a productive item or fluid identity. Modern roll declarations cannot grant productive identities on targets that do not support them.

Unexcluded fractional item outputs with zero base quantity remain useful on F210/F200. Typed material and existing lab-science selectors consume the corrected facts. Carrier guards, author denial, owners and stable research identities remain in force.

Controlled canonical fact/matcher checks cover all nine target contracts. Excluded-base fractional output, upstream finalizers, current-package production, catalogue changes and saved-world behavior still require their affected native evidence.

target_dispositions.reason: Shared productive-output projection follows the target roll contract. Controlled checks do not qualify native production, catalogue or saved-world behavior.
